# SCI-FRUIT: admitted scientific boundaries and conventions

Status: sanitized extracts for exact packet review. Source identities and
scope are fixed by the companion input manifest. These extracts do not admit
any numerical route or permit access to unlisted source documents.

## B1. Scientific identity and lifecycle

Adopt the existing convention that iteration identifiers are zero-based and
absolute across exact restart: continuation after completed iteration N starts
at N+1. A seed initializes a new lineage; it is not an exact restart.
Requested policy, effective plan, observation-resolved state and realized
application are distinct. Scientific identity must state the quantity, unit,
frame, grouping, indexing, support, validity and generation needed for its use.
Container positions or equal dimensions do not supply scientific identity.

The approved causal-completeness obligation is that any information capable
of changing a future required result is causal state.

## B2. PTC ownership and exact application

Source authority: SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5, frozen 2026-08-23, and its exact
PTC-to-MAP/JINC handoff boundaries in their respective authority roles.

PTC owns its calibrated-input transformation, correlated-mode cleaning,
coefficient families, fitted/resolved/applied state and validity. The
calibration and coordinate producers retain their own upstream authority.
FRUIT may define the placement and state/generation binding of a PTC operation
inside a feedback procedure; it may not choose or redefine the PTC estimator.

The PTC total removed signal is the input-output difference, which is distinct
from the fitted correlated component alone. Its transformed output is not an
independent sky estimate. The fixed-state linear null, modes made invariant
or unidentifiable by re-estimating centering, and the affine loss from a
discarded additive reference are distinct loss roles.

An ordinary fixed-state PCA/SVD application freezes the realized detector
loading subspace, metric, centering, support and other material application
state. Application coefficients are recomputed against that frozen subspace
according to the PTC-owned map. Freezing a numerical removed component and
subtracting it from every new input is a separately named affine family;
it is not interchangeable with frozen-subspace projection. The ordinary PTC
application requires its declared finite full-rank time-local normal matrix;
deficiency is unavailable under that authority, not permission to lower rank,
borrow another group or use a partial projection.

Use the exact PTC-defined application as an input to the core's composition.
Do not rederive PCA, assign a mode count or presume that a nominal fixed
configuration fixes every learned operator. A frozen state and the rule that
applies that state together define the conditional transformation.

The [PTC application excerpt](PTC_APPLICATION_REFERENCE_R0.1.tex) preserves
the exact frozen equations and their support/rank restrictions for this
distinction. In that excerpt, g is a declared detector group and t a time
sample; the centered row is x, the frozen loading matrix is A, W is the
time-local application-influence mask or weight, and G is its normal matrix.
Theta denotes the complete resolved group state, including the application
map. The excerpt is inherited PTC mathematics, not a choice of FRUIT cleaning
route, rank, metric or model. Cite it where needed; do not commission its
derivation again.

## B3. Map and JINC producers

Source authorities: SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.7.1, frozen 2026-08-28, and SCI-JINC
v0.1/r0.3, frozen 2026-08-29.

MAP and JINC retain their own estimands, normalization, grouping, coefficient
and coordinate bindings, support, validity and numerical admission. An exact
PTC output, coefficient/QC identity and compatible coordinate association are
producer/consumer facts; a label, time or row coincidence does not establish
the same processed occurrence. A MAP-permitted coefficient family does not
automatically permit JINC use.

A normalized map is not automatically a deconvolved or unbiased sky model.
Constructing a feedback model requires a declared scientific relation to its
target and a compatible projector. Observation and coadd products are distinct
groupings; their transformations do not commute by default.

JINC is a signed normalized observation-map estimator. Its base authority
does not inherit ordinary MAP coaddition or expose a base JINC response,
variance, formal-weight, covariance, empirical-noise or significance product
merely because those concepts can be discussed. The core
may state conditional response/covariance obligations for a future admitted
FRUIT method, but may not manufacture a JINC product or resolve a missing
JINC authority. No formal weight is promoted to covariance or significance.

No numerical MAP/JINC route is admitted in this packet. A frozen scientific
description alone does not supply missing numerical coefficients, parameters,
support/adequacy decisions or compatible response information. Filtered and
unfiltered quantities are not interchangeable; this core admits no filtering
route, inverse or provisional filter authority.

## B4. NOI ownership and uncertainty

Source authority: scientific-owner-approved SCI-NOI-ODQ-110C, 2026-08-30.
This is the approved FRUIT ownership/conditioning boundary, not a claim that
the whole NOI package or a numerical FRUIT uncertainty route is frozen.

FRUIT owns its source model, subtraction/add-back, state, recurrence,
iteration, stopping, restart, selection, response, support, validity and
failure. NOI owns the ensemble/uncertainty method and its exact binding.

For an exact immutable FRUIT residual or terminal transformation, a permitted
NOI method must apply that same owner-defined transformation to every admitted
compatible randomization. The result is conditional on its frozen state.
It excludes unmodeled learning, selection, convergence, restart, source-model
and leakage variation. If the transformation and parity cannot be supplied,
that numerical uncertainty route is unavailable.

If a prior uncertainty product informs later FRUIT learning or selection, it
is dependent input to a new immutable FRUIT/science/ensemble/uncertainty
generation. It is not independent validation and is not changed retroactively.
Partial or complete FRUIT replay per realization is a separate method with a
complete member-specific state graph. Fixed and replayed members cannot be
pooled without a separately authorized mixture estimand. No numerical
covariance model, noise equivalence, calibrated significance or independence
is supplied here.

## B5. Consumer and claim boundaries

FRUIT supplies exact product/iteration/response identity and truthful validity
for its declared role. Source fitting, catalogue inference, Pointing and OOF
retain their estimands and fitness requirements. VAL can register/evaluate
producer-owned criteria; it does not author FRUIT numerical policy.

Producer validity, FRUIT model admission, conditional-response availability,
uncertainty availability and consumer fitness are distinct propositions.
Absence of one companion does not authorize silent replacement or a universal
veto on every other product. State the exact dependency for the requested use.

Scientific authority, implementation conformity, empirical performance,
qualification, readiness and production permission remain separate. No
numerical method or population is admitted by any extract in this packet.
